Woodburn Avenue north of Dana is printed only 'AVENUE' (y ~900); the name comes from 'WOODBURN' printed on the same street south of Dana and the 'Woodburn Ave. Synd.' subdivisions along it. Its width is printed 60' at the top and '66'' at Brewster. The N-S street between Mougey and Dana (45 ft) is printed only 'AVE.' and lines up with Idlewild south of Dana. Brewster is printed 'BREWSTER' with 'HERBERT AVE.' in small type next to it. Herald, Idlewild and Brewster: no suffix printed in this strip.
